plain: In December 2017 the New York Times newspaper ran an article about UFOs written with a journalist named Leslie Kean. A UFO documentary filmmaker, James Fox, says it was her biggest story and one of the most popular the paper ever published. A skeptic, Mick West, says the article was co-written with Ralph Blumenthal and came with Navy videos called Gimbal and FLIR1, with another, Go Fast, released a little later. Why it matters, as told, is that it brought the subject out of the fringe. An analyst, Matthew Pines, describes the articles as the start of a slow, semi-official acceptance of a topic that had been an outsider culture. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a former official named Lue Elizondo helped get the article published through Kean while he was in charge of AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports. So it is told by the host, a filmmaker, an analyst and a skeptic alike, each stressing a different side.
